rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for virtual reality as a technology or experience.

example.english: I put on a headset and played virtual reality, and it felt like I had gone into space.
example.traditional: 我戴住頭盔玩虛擬現實，成個人好似去咗太空咁。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai3 zyu6 tau4 kwai1 waan2 heoi1 ji4 jin6 sat6 seng4 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 heoi3 zo2 taai3 hung1 gam3

rows.note: A speaker uses this equally valid term when emphasizing the immersive simulated environment itself.

example.english: This virtual reality version of old Hong Kong is so lifelike that I don't want to leave.
example.traditional: 呢個虛擬實境整到古代香港好逼真，我行到唔捨得走。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 heoi1 ji4 sat6 ging2 zing2 dou2 gu2 doi6 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 bik1 zan1 ngo5 haang4 dou3 m4 se2 dak1 zau2
